ios.desc:
Turn every soak into a story you can learn from.

Furolog is a bathing journal for onsen, sento, sauna and cold-plunge fans. With a compatible Apple Watch, it detects when you enter the water and records temperature and heart rate, building a timeline of every soak, rest, sauna and cold plunge. Prefer to stay in control? Record manually from Apple Watch or iPhone.

Sensor-based water temperature tracking is available on Apple Watch Series 10 or later and Apple Watch Ultra models.

TRACK AS YOU BATHE
• Automatic water detection on compatible Apple Watch models
• Water temperature changes recorded as often as every 5 seconds
• Continuous heart rate monitoring with configurable alerts
• Manual dip, sauna and temperature controls on Apple Watch and iPhone
• A clear activity timeline for every soak, rest, sauna and cold plunge
• Tag sessions with 13 onsen water types and 12 sauna types

REMEMBER EVERY VISIT
• Add ratings, notes and photos to your sessions
• Save favorite sessions and facilities
• See your complete visit history for each location
• Keep your journal in sync across devices with iCloud

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT STOP
• Find nearby onsen, sento and sauna on an interactive map
• Track the prefectures you have visited and aim for all 47
• See community water temperatures and visit totals when available

UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS — FUROLOG PRO
• Explore temperature, duration and frequency trends
• Review heart rate zones, HR response and post-session recovery
• Follow heat tolerance, cold tolerance and hot-cold contrast
• See your sauna heart rate climb and recovery pattern
• Find Your Perfect Session from the routines you rate highest

MAKE IT YOURS
• Create share cards in three layouts with customizable gradient backgrounds
• Add photo backgrounds and choose from 9 alternate app icons with Furolog Pro
• Choose from 7 themes
• Use Furolog in English or Japanese

All recording features on Apple Watch and iPhone are free. Furolog Pro unlocks advanced analytics and additional customization.

PRIVACY AND PERMISSIONS
Community sharing is optional and can be disabled globally or for individual sessions. Shared records are anonymized and used to provide facility water temperatures and visit totals. Notes, photos, heart rate data, exact timestamps, home addresses and precise locations are never shared.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built an app using Apple Watch's water and HR sensors to track baths

quotes.text:
Hey HN! First Show HN for me - niche app, but I think it nails something that hasn't been done properly before.

Furolog (フロログ — furo = bath, log = logging) is an iOS + watchOS app that uses the Apple Watch underwater temperature sensor to automatically track onsen, sento, and sauna sessions. Everything runs and is stored locally.

How it works: The core is an algorithm built on CMWaterSubmersionManager, heart rate, and motion data that detects whether you're bathing, resting, or in a sauna and segments sessions accordingly: hot bath, cold plunge, sauna, rest. No manual input. I think this is one of the few genuinely valid use cases for CMWaterSubmersionManager outside of diving.

Automatic detection isn't perfect — and probably never will be, since everyone's body responds differently to heat. There's a manual mode for that, and anything that doesn't happen in water requires confirmation before it's logged :)

I also went fairly deep into the physiology literature while working on this. HR zones in the app are adapted from sport training zones to reflect thermal stress rather than exercise effort, along with cold interval recovery metrics and a few other tidbits I found interesting while researching.
